tasks.short: Study animal requirements and feed nutritive values

steps.what: Read actual nutrition studies and capture species, life-stage, feed and measurement definitions
Design the actual comparison of nutritional requirements and feed values
Carry out the actual nutrition study observations and collect feed and animal-response data
Assemble selected nutrient fields and calculate fixed feed-value comparisons
Verify the comparisons and interpret actual nutritional requirements and feed limitations
Write the actual working nutrition findings and comparability limits
Save the working nutrition record in the same store

tasks.design: Render selected study and feed-analysis fields from {OTHER}, the animal-study and feed-analysis record system, into fixed {SPREADSHEET} comparisons. Keep source selection, study work, interpretation and actual working findings with the scientist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected nutrition fields could be copied and calculated separately after study capture.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit species, life-stage, unit and feed-basis fields support repeatable arithmetic.
tasks.still_hard: Different feed bases and study populations can make apparent nutrient comparisons invalid.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist decides whether the evidence supports a nutritional requirement.

ambition.what: Compare an additional feed material against the same defined nutrition-study basis.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit nutrition fields support fixed comparisons while species and study comparability remain scientific judgments.

assumptions: Boundary is an actual nutrition-study episode and its working findings, not an invented farm treatment or external report.

The scientist captures species, life stage, feed identifier, analysis date, measurement basis, units, value and source locator in s1-s3. Actual observation and mapping effort remain counted; missing fields stay manual.
Test native study exports and calculations first. Existing automatic calculations and measurement runtime earn zero new labour saving.

Any actual externally communicated recommendation, publication or animal-care change requires its real authority and separate action. Ordinary same-system save1 is near-zero fully retained and ungated.
Shares are unmeasured episode estimates; source work shared with practice development or a paper must be counted once.
research_questions: Which nutrition fields can be compared without new biological interpretation?

already_counted.description: Source mapping, design, actual study work, interpretation and working-record writing remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain feed-basis mappings and unit test cases.

steps.what: Read the actual verified research results and capture source, figure and reference locators
Choose the actual scientific message, audience and limitations to explain
Assemble selected result tables, figures and references in the communication template
Write the actual research explanation for the selected scientific and producer audience

loop.input: checked results, selected references and audience outline
loop.check: scientist verifies every result, interpretation and citation against actual sources
loop.stop: one draft and correction pass; unsupported claims are removed or written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Audience-specific scientific explanation needs prose beyond a figure template.

steps.what: Check the complete communication, figures, citations and submission details
Save the final working package in the same store
Perform the actual corresponding-author release review of the final coauthored communication
Submit the exact released written communication to its actual external recipient
Orally communicate the actual findings and answer scientific or producer questions

tasks.design: Assemble selected outputs from {OTHER}, the study record system, in {DOCS} and draft explanation through a bounded source-based loop. Keep interpretation and complete checks with the scientist, the actual corresponding-author release route, the separate {EMAIL} submission and the oral discussion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing research communication repeated figure assembly and first-draft explanation.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned result locators support deterministic assembly and checked draft prose.
tasks.still_hard: Producer-friendly explanation must preserve scientific uncertainty and avoid overstated findings.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist explains meaning and responds to audience questions.

ambition.what: Prepare a producer-facing explanation from the same verified result package.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: selected research outputs and source-bound draft prose can support communication while interpretation and complete checking remain human.

assumptions: This is a real coauthored written-and-oral communication episode where a different corresponding author already releases the written version. Do not add that role to a solo-author episode; use the actual authority route and its real work.

The scientist checks and maps study identifier, result version, figure locator, source identifier and audience in s1-s2. Upstream study production is real work in its study task, counted once, not a free result feed.
The final complete package and recipient exist before s7. Any result, wording, attachment or recipient change voids a1. Author checking in s5 is content work, not self-approval of a save.
Test native document templates first. Existing generated figures earn no new saving. Actual external submission is its own fully retained step; oral discussion remains human.
Save1 is near-zero fully retained and ungated. Shares are unmeasured activity estimates, not time-share priors.
unknowns: Template compatibility and publication-versus-oral episode mix
research_questions: What drafting time remains after every scientific claim and source is checked?

Actual separate corresponding-author review remains counted outside the focal denominator.

steps.what: Read actual feeding, housing, sanitation and health-control evidence relevant to the practice question
Design the actual permitted practice comparison and its observation criteria
Carry out actual observations of the permitted comparison and capture animal and production responses
Develop the improved practice from actual results and capture its steps and limitations
Assemble the selected practice steps, result references and fixed working-record sections
Check the complete improved-practice record against results, species and operating limitations
Save the working practice record in the same store

tasks.design: Use a native {DOCS} template to assemble the scientist's selected practice steps and actual result references from {OTHER}, the animal-production study record system. Keep evidence gathering, the actual comparison, practice development and complete checks with the scientist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Working practice records repeated copying of selected steps and study references.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed practice fields and source locators support repeatable assembly without choosing animal-care changes.
tasks.still_hard: A practice that works in one production setting may not transfer to another species or housing system.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist weighs biological response, welfare and practical constraints.

ambition.what: No autonomous animal-care intervention or expanded health authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: selected practice steps and result references can populate a working record while practice development remains scientific judgment.

assumptions: Boundary is development from an actual permitted comparison, including the working record. It does not authorize a new experiment, treatment or farm rollout; any actual intervention or external issue requires its real authority and separate action.

The scientist produces the comparison design in s2, captures actual species, setting, practice version, observation and result locators in s3, and supplies chosen practice steps and limits in s4. No free clean experimental feed.
Test native templates first. Already assembled records earn zero new saving; actual observations and study runtime remain fully retained.
Save1 is near-zero fully retained and ungated; author checking is content work, not self-approval. Shares are unmeasured activity estimates.
If nutrition-study data from task5415 are the actual same comparison, deduplicate their capture and study work before roll-up.
research_questions: Can each assembled practice step retain its explicit evidence and applicability limit?

incremental.description: Maintain practice-field mappings and result-reference checks.

tasks.short: Advise producers on improved products and techniques

steps.what: Find relevant species-specific product and technique evidence in the approved reference collection
Assess the producer's actual animals, production setting and practical constraints
Advise the producer on suitable products and techniques and discuss limits and questions
Write the actual working advisory note with context, references and unresolved questions
Save the ordinary advisory note in the same store

tasks.design: Configure species and production-setting filters in the approved {DOCS} reference collection. Keep the actual producer assessment, advice conversation and working advisory note with the scientist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant evidence could require repeated searches across the reference collection.
tasks.enabler_now: Native species, technique and publication-version metadata can narrow source retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Published results may not transfer to the producer's actual animals and facilities.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist adapts advice to the producer's constraints and explains uncertainty.

ambition.what: No expanded veterinary or farm operating authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: filtered reference retrieval can support producer advice while applicability judgment and conversation remain human.

assumptions: This is an actual advisory episode with its genuine working note, not a new report after every informal conversation. A written producer recommendation, external send or purchase commitment needs its actual final authority and separate action if present.

The producer supplies actual context in s2 and the scientist captures advice in s4. Existing reference metadata includes species, setting, technique and source version; resolving absent metadata stays in s1.
Test native views first. Already available reference filters earn zero new saving; no machine product selection or diagnosis is proposed.
Same-system save1 is near-zero fully retained and ungated. Shares are unmeasured estimates; upstream research shared with another task is counted once.
research_questions: Do filters retrieve genuinely applicable evidence without extra tagging?

already_counted.description: Reference verification, producer assessment, actual advice and note authorship remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain advice-reference filters and inspect stale versions.

role.altitude: Biological interpretation, actual study work and producer relationships stay central; selected result assembly and first drafting take less time.
reach: Work with the feed analyst on basis and unit conventions; learn how analysis versions and moisture bases affect comparability.
role.ambitious_version: A scientist who compares traceable evidence and communicates it clearly while preserving animal-care and scientific decision boundaries.
